name: Doppelkopf
summary: German 4-player trick-taking with double 24-card deck and hidden partnerships via queens of clubs.
rules_text: Use double deck of 24 cards: each suit A,K,Q,J,10,9 twice (2x24 = 48). In normal game trumps are 10H, all Qs, all Js, A,10,K,9 diamonds (26). Other suits are side suits. Cards have Skat values A=11,10=10,K=4,Q=3,J=2. Deal all cards 3 at a time, 12 each. Bidding round: each says Gesund or Vorbehalt. Vorbehalt types ranked: Hochzeit, Armut, Solo. Highest plays. If all Gesund, holders of two club queens are partners Re vs Kontra; if one player holds both, that is silent solo vs three. Hochzeit holder gets first other trick winner as partner, else solo if first three tricks won by holder. Armut holder with <=3 trumps lays all trumps face down; clockwise first accepter takes them and returns 3 discards. Solo: declarer vs three with altered trumps (suit solo, queen-only, jack-only, or no trump). Play 12 tricks, must follow suit/trump suit, highest trump or led suit wins, first equal wins. Re needs 121 points, Kontra 120. During play while holding >=11 cards Re/Kontra can announce Re/Kontra, then with 10/9/8/7 cards No 90/60/30/Schwarz to raise score.
